## Change and reason

Describe the change and the problem it addresses. Link an existing issue when relevant.

## Verification

Describe the checks performed and their results. The repository currently has no runtime test suite; do not report tests that do not exist.

## Compatibility and privacy

Explain any changed claims, links or user-facing behavior and any remaining risks.

- [ ] The change stays within the documented contribution scope.
- [ ] Links and factual claims have been checked; affected documentation is updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private configuration, prompts, transcripts or raw provider logs are included.
- [ ] The Code of Conduct has been read.
